_comment: BRO-2688 baseline: audit-*.js scripts that no workflow, action, package.json script or other code references. Wire a new audit into CI instead of adding it here; add it only when it is intentionally manual (bucket b). Reasoning: docs/triage-audit-scripts.md.

audit-star-bands.js.reason: CLAUDE.md §3 star-band invariant; core data only; live run today shows 1 review out of band (scoreSource originalScore-priority0)

audit-announced-cast.js.reason: announced shows must not hold an older production's cast (BRO-5809); core data only; live run today flags the-wedding-march-off-broadway-2026

audit-scoreless-llmscore.js.reason: files with an llmScore object but no numeric score are never scored or published (BRO-5395); needs review-texts

audit-uncounted-real-reviews.js.reason: review texts on 2026 shows missing from reviews.json (BRO-5794); needs review-texts

audit-listing-page-text.js.reason: listing or search page scored as a review (BRO-5375, scored 87 on the site); only a test.yml path trigger today; needs review-texts

audit-promo-booking-copy.js.reason: booking and deal copy ingested as review text (BRO-5902, BRO-5906); only a test.yml path trigger today; needs review-texts

audit-ownership-gate-losses.js.reason: reviews dropped by the push ownership gate that exist nowhere in the corpus (BRO-5373); needs review-texts git history

audit-corpus-determinism.js.reason: published review count moving down or flapping; PASS today; needs deploy-watermark git history

audit-flagged-file-contamination.js.reason: merge target landing inside a flagged review file (BRO-3219); only a test.yml path trigger; needs review-texts

audit-stale-review-texts.js.reason: stale manual-clear reasons hiding genuinely wrong texts (BRO-2395); only a test.yml path trigger; needs review-texts

audit-shared-url-quote.js.reason: multi-show column copied whole onto each show (BRO-4594); report only; needs review-texts

audit-form-d-capitalization.js.reason: commercial.json capitalization stored as the Form D maximum (BRO-5732); clean today (0 of 37); core data plus SEC fetch

audit-excluded-with-own-show-evidence.js.reason: BRO-5805 read-only sweep, needs the private review-texts corpus (cloud-run-script --review-texts); --gate mode is not wired; promote to (a) if a run with review-texts finds hits

audit-feature-as-review.js.reason: read-only sweep from the BRO-5420 incident; promote to (a) if a run with review-texts finds hits

audit-demoted-nonreview.js.reason: read-only sweep from the BRO-5420 incident; promote to (a) if a run with review-texts finds hits

audit-uk-rows-on-broadway.js.reason: read-only sweep from the BRO-5420 incident; promote to (a) if a run with review-texts finds hits

audit-scored-other-critic.js.reason: read-only sweep from the BRO-5420 follow-up; promote to (a) if a run with review-texts finds hits

audit-director-guard-dates.js.reason: read-only cousin sweep for BRO-5373; promote to (a) if a run with review-texts finds hits

audit-critic-name-apostrophe.js.reason: read-only sweep for BRO-5444 truncated critic names; promote to (a) if a run with review-texts finds hits

audit-split-section-scores.js.reason: read-only sweep for BRO-6000 split-section back-references; needs review-texts and judgment per hit

audit-cast-matching.js.reason: one-shot re-evaluation of cast files against new IBDB matching rules

audit-critic-listing-parity.js.reason: one-shot parity check for decideCriticListingPromotion (task 995); sprint-scoped

audit-data-quality.js.reason: metrics dump to stdout for ad-hoc inspection; no pass/fail

audit-feedback-overnight-branches.js.reason: inspects local checkouts of the iOS app repo; cannot run in CI

audit-stranded-reviewed-branches.js.reason: inspects local worktrees; exits 2 as untrustworthy where none exist; Mac-only

audit-image-aspect.js.reason: poster geometry check over a local image archive; hygiene, not correctness

audit-roundup-coverage.js.reason: CLI wrapper for a pasted editorial roundup; manual input by design

audit-outlet-text-status.js.reason: one outlet's text coverage on demand; diagnostic with an outlet argument

audit-non-quote-excerpts.js.reason: diagnostic count for BRO-5344; no pass/fail threshold

audit-title-quality.js.reason: title artifact buckets, report only (BRO-3915); hygiene

audit-tour-leg-venues.js.reason: report-only corpus audit (BRO-2278); needs judgment per hit

audit-always-commit-after-validate.js.reason: advisory workflow linter (BRO-5293); exits 0 by design, rule 19 forbids arming it

audit-flat-git-add.js.reason: advisory workflow linter (BRO-2945); exits 0 by design, rule 19 forbids arming it

audit-apply-scripts-verify-pushed.js.reason: Finds --apply scripts that write review texts without verify-review-texts-pushed, risking fixes left only on disk; schedule as a source-only advisory count, not a blocking gate.

audit-audience-scores.js.reason: Checks audience-buzz score ranges, source weights, designations and staleness against shows.json; recurring published-data drift merits a digest using report severity counts; no network calls.

audit-awards-data.js.reason: Checks awards.json for orphan show IDs, duplicate nominations, impossible wins and season gaps; recurring catalog edits can regress these, so schedule severity counts; needs awards.json, no network calls.

audit-bro79-ensemble-rejections.js.reason: One-time repair of named July 2026 ensemble rejections and a Wicked excerpt recovery; writes private review files by default unless --dry-run, so never schedule as a recurring audit.

audit-close-time-verify.js.reason: Pre-rollout experiment that lists cards through retired notion-brain.js and executes their acceptance commands in a fresh checkout; manual migration evidence, not a daily data-health check.

audit-content-quality.js.reason: Legacy mixed heuristic sweep includes extractYearFromUrl for production guesses and broad byline/domain checks; keep manual without --fix until checks use sourced metadata under CLAUDE.md section 3.

audit-coverage-slot-drops.js.reason: Finds aggregator URL slots, other-critic URL ownership, dateless holds and stale non-review slots with replacement reviews; recurring ingest losses merit candidate counts; needs review-texts, no fetches.

audit-creative-team-serp.js.reason: Retro-audits unprovenanced non-Broadway creative credits predating the SERP guard; two searches per member plus optional Opus adjudication and --fix require a scoped, budgeted manual run, not cron.

audit-critic-tenure.js.reason: Counts unresolved critic/outlet tenure mismatches using findTenureFlags and reviewed exceptions; new attribution errors warrant recurring visibility; needs review-texts, no network calls, supports --max.

audit-cross-attribution-by-critic.js.reason: Matches stored review content against title, cast, creative and venue fingerprints to detect wrong-show attribution; schedule report-only confidence counts with review-texts; never --apply on cron.

audit-doubled-market-ids.js.reason: Standing shows.json detector for market words leaking from titles into generated IDs; new discovery rows can repeat BRO-2886, so schedule sweepShows with its reviewed allowlist; core data only.

audit-duplicate-images.js.reason: Hashes hero, poster and thumbnail files for same-title productions; requires the complete local public/images/shows archive, tolerates absent files and writes a /tmp repair list, so use for image triage.

audit-excerpt-only-backfill-queue.js.reason: Reports excerpt-only files eligible for the existing daily unscored pipeline; queue size is not a failure or completion guarantee because scoring is capped, so use for manual backfill progress checks.

audit-explicit-scores.js.reason: Ranks originalScore suspects using positive/negative word lists and extraction-source hints; sentiment disagreement is not proof an explicit rating is wrong, so inspect evidence manually rather than alert on every hit.

audit-false-dead-ledger-rows.js.reason: Dispatch retry-cap incident probe fetches Linear comments per issue to corroborate dead ledger rows; the live gate already uses classifyDeadRowsForTask, so reserve the extra API scan for investigations.

audit-fetch-timeouts.js.reason: Scans source for fetch and HTTP request call sites lacking a matched abort or destroy timeout; recurring hang regressions merit source-only advisory counts; full scan intentionally exits 0 on existing debt.

audit-field-consistency.js.reason: Detects wordCount, contentTier and legacy text-status drift that can change rebuild inclusion; schedule the default report over review-texts, never --fix; no network calls.

audit-flag-wipe-signature.js.reason: Retroactive scan for the pre-16c834c9 maybeUpgradeUrl exclusion-flag wipe breadcrumb; incident-cohort repair needs per-hit review of legitimate clears, not a standing count of all URL changes.

audit-git-show-maxbuffer.js.reason: Finds git show/cat-file/ls-tree/diff/log subprocesses missing maxBuffer, which can misread large data files as absent; recurring source regressions merit a cheap offline check.

audit-grosses-data.js.reason: Adds snapshot staleness, missing open Broadway shows, ATP and all-time consistency checks beyond the wired history-integrity rules; schedule severity counts with shows and both grosses files; no fetches.

audit-late-add-corpus-wide.js.reason: Historical late-add census deliberately includes closed shows outside the production ledger window; existing opening-night coverage handles current targets, so use this snapshot for scoped historical cleanup.

audit-levenshtein-matches.js.reason: Pre-migration inventory of fuzzy critic-name matches to decide which true typos belong in CRITIC_ALIASES; pairs require human identity review before changing matching rules, not recurring alerts.

audit-llm-hallucinations.js.reason: Uses canonical keyword checks to find LLM-verified live text lacking show identity and quarantine-gate contradictions; schedule separate suspect counts with review-texts, not automatic reclassification; no LLM calls.

audit-llm-scores.js.reason: Blind re-scoring experiment with provider calls, retries, calibration and a spend cap; use --pass1-only or a scoped funded investigation, not an unrestricted daily cron.

audit-llm-scoring-parity.js.reason: Runs the real rebuild and LLM scoreability predicates over review-texts to expose wasted scoring and orphan-unscored divergences; schedule bucketed report counts, accounting for intentional differences; no LLM calls.

audit-london-outlet-flags.js.reason: BRO-5896 recovery diagnostic groups held and self-healed NYC reviews by current outlet region; legitimate London holds and released totals are not defects, so inspect suspect regions manually rather than gate total flags.

audit-mirror-status-drift.js.reason: Samples local ~/.claude/tasks mirror entries against live Notion statuses; depends on retired Notion tooling and a workstation mirror, so keep as historical investigation tooling, not CI.

audit-multi-production-titles.js.reason: Generates same-title production groups as fixtures for routing work; revivals and transfers legitimately share titles, so a collision count alone is not an alertable defect.

audit-multi-verdict-stars.js.reason: Finds stored star ratings borrowed from another section of multi-review articles; schedule mismatch counts separately from ambiguous sections using review-texts; --write-plan stays manual, no fetches.

audit-multishow-titlecase.js.reason: A/B replay of titlecase, URL-evidence and flag-clearing rules for BRO-5373/BRO-5395; changed verdicts need cohort adjudication and can retain other exclusions, so run during rule/backfill investigations.

audit-nonreview-cv-conflict.js.reason: Counts stale isNonReview flags intentionally outranked by fresher verification at read time; these persist on disk and need not drain to zero, so the optional ceiling is diagnostic, not a daily failure signal.

audit-nyt-pick-coverage.js.reason: Proposes missing NYT Pick reviews using title words in URL slugs and run windows; matches need sourced confirmation under the no-URL-metadata rule before ingestion, so keep candidate research manual.

audit-opening-night-extraction.js.reason: Post-opening verification requires an explicit --show and live BWW/DTLI pages or cached --no-live inputs; run for a selected opening after reviews exist, not as an unscoped daily catalog scan.

audit-opera-discovery-gap.js.reason: Replays outlet-site discovery to classify misses for a selected show/category and opening window; live listing fetches can use Bright Data and need a bounded research scope, not a default full-catalog cron.

audit-orphan-inprogress.js.reason: One-time drain of local mirrored in-progress tasks using cmux, git evidence and retired Notion cards; --fix mutates tasks and cards, and CI lacks the workstation sessions it must corroborate.

audit-orphaned-audit-writes.js.reason: Finds workflow audit reports discarded because commit steps never stage them; schedule the source-only --check ratchet against reviewed persistence gaps, with shadow-mode visibility before blocking.

audit-outlet-tiers.js.reason: Builds outlet volume/evidence tables and simulates proposed tier changes from supplied justifications; tier policy needs sourced human decisions and explicit output files, so no automatic recurring gate.

audit-paywall-leaks.js.reason: Detects subscriber-login boilerplate stored as fullText via the shared positional paywall detector; recurring cookie failures merit a weekly report with review-texts and --strict in shadow mode; no fetches.

audit-registry-nonreview-outlets.js.reason: One-time pre-guard registry cross-check against venue, PR and ticketing host rules; domain collisions can flag real scored outlets, so use findings as manual evidence and never remove registry rows on a cron.

audit-reroute-backlog.js.reason: One-time inventory of already-flagged reviews that might fit sibling productions; requires the main checkout and .core-data-checkout/shows.json plus collision/year-only adjudication, so keep repair planning manual.

audit-review-pair-anomalies.js.reason: Detects identical text under different critics/URLs and stale own-domain roundup flags across sibling files; per-file guards miss these, so schedule report-only pair and roundup counts with review-texts.

audit-safe-form-allowlist.js.reason: Source-only read-only-allowlist invariants already run in scripts/lib/safe-form-allowlist.test.mjs, including transitive writes and live-gate agreement; CLI --candidates is manual admission research, so no duplicate cron.

audit-show-score-url-redirects.js.reason: Live per-URL HTTP probe for Show Score mappings redirecting to generic listings; use --show or --limit to investigate a suspected mapping, alongside the offline archive audit, rather than refetch the whole map daily.

audit-single-author-mismatches.js.reason: Uses critic distribution and staff-turnover exceptions to propose multiAuthor registry changes; low-data and legitimate turnover cases need attribution review, and --apply changes scoring inputs, so keep manual.

audit-soft-404-review-texts.js.reason: Finds stored soft-404 templates and byte-identical bodies across critics, complementing the collector guard on newly fetched text; schedule read-only finding counts with review-texts, no live fetches.

audit-stale-open-premises.js.reason: Backlog research runs open cards acceptance commands in a fresh checkout and marks only stale-premise candidates; broad tests and absent private data are inconclusive, so results need owner judgment, not automatic cron action.

audit-text-gap-cards.js.reason: Card-specific evidence for BRO-4426, BRO-4564 and BRO-4301, selected with --card and named repair plans; each cohort measures a different text-recovery hypothesis, so use for those investigations.

audit-truncated-reviews.js.reason: Legacy local heuristic inventory of suspicious endings, paywall phrases and short bodies; findings need article inspection and reuse of current collector rules before becoming a recurring alert signal.

audit-url-collisions.js.reason: Classifies same-show/outlet URL groups to separate legitimate aggregator multi-critic pages from copied-text contamination; schedule contamination counts with review-texts, never --apply; no network calls.

audit-url-validation.js.reason: Retroactive roundup-URL investigation mixes URL-title guesses, cached archives and potentially paid fetchPage validation; needs a bounded scope and content-based evidence before recurring use, not a default daily sweep.

audit-we-historical-season.js.reason: Manual release gate for a specified West End backfill --season about seven days after scoring; displayability, run windows, duplicates and provenance determine whether the next season can start, not daily catalog health.

audit-we-market-misroutes.js.reason: Historical backlog replay of gather-time market routing over flagged West End files; --execute moves private review files and collisions need adjudication, while the standing ingest guard handles new rows.

audit-we-reviews.js.reason: Live review refetch plus OpenAI and Gemini adjudication per review; default --limit is unbounded and production/sentiment findings need evidence review, so use a funded manual sample, not cron.

audit-wet-roundup-bleed.js.reason: Cross-checks cached WET roundup rows and review files for borrowed critics/URLs and cross-outlet domains; schedule unflagged contamination counts, keeping weak leads separate; needs WET archive and review-texts, no fetches.

audit-workflow-activity.js.reason: Whole-workflow inventory complements the existing critical-cron monitor; refresh costs about two GitHub API calls per workflow before retries, so use cached/manual retirement reviews rather than daily duplicate polling.

audit-wrong-article-parity.js.reason: BRO-3956 diagnostic compares wrongArticle checks to canonical rejection; medium-confidence and manual-clear disagreements are intentional in URL ownership routing, so a nonzero parity count is not a recurring defect.

audit-wt-integ-stashes.js.reason: Read-only triage of the shared workstation stash stack, including dangerous truncations; CI has no representative wt-integ recovery stashes, so run during local stash cleanup, never as a catalog cron.

audit-timeout-patterns.js.reason: Finds Promise.race timeout wrappers whose timers are never cleared, causing scripts to linger after work ends; schedule the offline source scan as a regression signal, using withTimeout as the repair.

audit-guard-call-sites.js.reason: BRO-2484 advisory heuristic: flags audience-facing guards with a unit test but no test proving the call site; run by hand (--strict to fail), exercised by tests/unit/audit-guard-call-sites.test.mjs

audit-lane-trouble-rate.js.reason: BRO-2978: manual read of per-lane dispatch retry burn from the per-machine dispatch ledger (gitignored, absent in CI), so no workflow can run it

audit-malformed-review-urls.js.reason: BRO-5162: read-only sweep of review-texts url values; needs the private review-texts corpus, so run it through cloud-run-script. The write-time guard (review-write-guard) is the standing prevention.
